description: Running a long task so it survives crashes and restarts: progress is recorded and the run continues where it stopped without redoing completed work.
The saved state of a run (conversation, step count, status, answer) under a run id, written after every step.
A save that either fully replaces the old checkpoint or leaves it untouched, for example a temporary file renamed over the original.
A stable identifier sent with a side-effecting request so the receiving service performs it at most once, even when it is retried.
Saving the tool calls a model requested before executing them, so a resumed run can see which calls are unfinished.
How workflow engines resume: the code runs again from the start, and recorded results replace the steps that already completed.
